desc: This TAC Standard FS is outfitted with standard Novak style sights and is chambered in 45 ACP. The firearm is equipped with rear slide serrations and a tactical rail. The TAC Standard FS comes in two configurations, the single-stack model, which comes in a 45 caliber barrel, and the high-capacity model, which comes in 45 or 9mm. Both have a full dust cover rail to even the weight and reduce recoil. Upgrades included are ambidextrous safety, combat hammer, and extended beavertail for maximum comfort and safety.
